comment: 42yo female with long-standing endometriosis (>5 years; endometrioma confirmed on TVUS + pelvic MRI). No current ovarian cancer. Endometriosis-associated ovarian cancer (clear-cell/endometrioid subtypes) RR ~1.3-1.9 overall, up to ~3-4 for those histologies. Fires RF-REPRODUCTIVE-ENDOMETRIOSIS-OVARIAN-PREVENTION. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-REPRODUCTIVE-ENDOMETRIOSIS-OVARIAN-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (symptom awareness + risk-reducing salpingectomy discussion at completed childbearing); alternative = IND-REPRODUCTIVE-ENDOMETRIOSIS-OVARIAN-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (no population ovarian screening recommended).
